# Bayesian Modelling and Decisions under Uncertainty

> Build Bayesian models of uneven data, prove the computation and the code are sound, and turn the posterior into a decision with a price on further data. SDAIA Academy course DS-401, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 17,557 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: From priors to posteriors](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/slides/day1.md): Write the story that makes the data, test the priors by simulation, fit with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and read whether the computation can be trusted; sessions: Models that generate data, Priors you can defend, Fitting with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, Reading the computation; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/slides/day1.html; about 4,905 tokens
- [Day 2: Pooling across districts](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/slides/day2.md): Let districts with little data borrow strength from the others, and say what that borrowing does to the rural ones; sessions: No, complete and partial pooling, Group-level predictors, The funnel and non-centred models, Under-reporting as measurement error; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/slides/day2.html; about 4,315 tokens
- [Day 3: Is the model good enough](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/slides/day3.md): Check the model against its own data, compare candidates by prediction, prove the code right and measure what the priors decide; sessions: Posterior predictive checks, Comparing models by predictive accuracy, Is the code right, How much the priors matter; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/slides/day3.html; about 3,606 tokens
- [Day 4: From posterior to decision](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/slides/day4.md): Turn the posterior into a re-piping plan within budget, price the survey that would sharpen it, and review someone else’s analysis; sessions: Loss, utility and the decision table, Choosing under a budget, What more data is worth, Reviewing a Bayesian analysis; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/slides/day4.html; about 3,324 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone project presentations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/slides/capstone.md): An eight-minute presentation of the model and the decision, then seven minutes of questions: the assessor changes a prior or a cost, and a peer reviews the model; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/slides/capstone.html; about 986 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Simulate and recover a burst rate](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D1_1_simulate_burst_counts.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Prior predictive checks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D1_2_run_prior_predictive.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: A Poisson model with an offset](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D1_3_fit_poisson_model.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Four fits, two untrustworthy](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D1_4_flag_two_untrustworthy.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Three poolings and the rural districts](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D2_1_fit_all_three.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Material and age at the district level](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D2_2_add_pipe_material.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Repair a divergent model](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D2_3_repair_divergent_model.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: A reporting rate for districts without sensors](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D2_4_add_reporting_rate.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Zeros and dispersion](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D3_1_expose_poisson_misfit.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Three models by leave-one-out](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D3_2_compare_three_models.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Simulation-based calibration](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D3_3_locate_seeded_error.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Prior sensitivity](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D3_4_run_prior_sensitivity.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Replace, repair or wait](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D4_1_compute_expected_utility.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: A plan within the budget](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D4_2_choose_districts_re.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: The price of the leak survey](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D4_3_price_leak_survey.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Review an analysis, choose a brief](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-401/labs/D4_4_review_supplied_analysis.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
